guidance_scale_recommendations.tips: Higher = stricter prompt adherence, Lower = more creative freedom

text_to_video_templates.name: Cinematic travel shot
text_to_video_templates.prompt: A cinematic establishing shot of a serene mountain landscape at golden hour. Camera slowly pans across rolling peaks with warm, diffused sunlight casting long shadows. Mist rises from the valley below, creating atmospheric depth. Smooth, professional camera movement. 8K quality, natural color grading.

text_to_video_templates.name: Urban nightlife
text_to_video_templates.prompt: A bustling city street at night with neon signs and motion. Cars drive past with light trails, pedestrians move through the frame, buildings reflect in wet pavement. Moody, cinematic lighting with blues and magentas. Dynamic camera movement following the action. Professional video quality.

text_to_video_templates.name: Nature close-up
text_to_video_templates.prompt: Macro photography of dewdrops on a leaf, morning sunlight backlighting the droplets. Water droplet slowly rolls, creating ripples. Deep depth of field, blurred green background. Soft, natural lighting. Ultra-smooth motion, 4K resolution.

text_to_video_templates.name: Product showcase
text_to_video_templates.prompt: A sleek, modern product rotating slowly on a clean white surface. Studio lighting with soft shadows, highlights gleaming off the product. Camera circles around the product with smooth, professional motion. Minimal, luxury aesthetic. High-quality product photography.

text_to_video_templates.name: Abstract animation
text_to_video_templates.prompt: Swirling, flowing abstract shapes in vibrant neon colors: electric blues, hot pinks, and lime greens. Organic motion with liquid dynamics. Particles dance and merge. Smooth transitions between color shifts. Modern, energetic vibe. High energy motion design.

text_to_video_templates.name: Relaxation scene
text_to_video_templates.prompt: Peaceful spa scene: candles flickering softly, steam rising from hot water, smooth stones stacked carefully. Soft warm lighting with subtle camera movement. Calming, meditative atmosphere. Gentle, slow motion. Luxurious, serene mood. 4K quality.

text_to_video_templates.name: Food prep montage
text_to_video_templates.prompt: Fast-paced cooking montage: colorful vegetables being chopped, sizzling in a pan, sauce being poured. Quick cuts between actions. Warm kitchen lighting, appetizing colors. Professional food photography style. Dynamic, energetic pacing. Mouth-watering presentation.

text_to_video_templates.name: Weather phenomenon
text_to_video_templates.prompt: A lightning storm over the ocean. Dark storm clouds roil across the sky, lightning bolts crack across the frame, waves crash against rocks. Epic, dramatic atmosphere. Moody blue and grey color palette. Powerful, cinematic scale. Realistic weather simulation.

image_to_video_templates.name: Pan and zoom in
image_to_video_templates.prompt: Slowly zoom into the center of the image while panning gently. Reveal more detail as the camera moves closer. Maintain the lighting and color consistency from the original image.

image_to_video_templates.name: Steady 360 pan
image_to_video_templates.prompt: Rotate the camera smoothly around the subject in a full 360-degree rotation. Keep the same distance from the subject throughout. Maintain consistent lighting and perspective.

image_to_video_templates.name: Subtle parallax
image_to_video_templates.prompt: Apply a subtle parallax effect with slow, gentle camera movement. Different depths in the image move at slightly different speeds. Create subtle 3D depth perception while keeping motion minimal.

image_to_video_templates.name: Focus rack
image_to_video_templates.prompt: Start with focus on the foreground, gradually shift focus to the background, then back to foreground. Create smooth focus transitions. Maintain the original composition and lighting.

reference_to_video_templates.name: Lip-sync speaking
reference_to_video_templates.prompt: Character speaking naturally with clear mouth movements matching the audio. Maintain eye contact with camera. Natural head movements and expressions. Professional video quality.

reference_to_video_templates.name: Singing performance
reference_to_video_templates.prompt: Character singing expressively, mouth movements matching lyrics. Emotional facial expressions. Dynamic head and shoulder movements. Performance lighting. Music video style.

reference_to_video_templates.name: Narration with expression
reference_to_video_templates.prompt: Narrator speaking clearly with expressive facial movements. Authentic emotion matching the spoken content. Natural eye movement and subtle head turns. Professional speaking voice sync.
